x-tools.name: tdev_workspace
x-tools.description: List authorized repositories and exact heads; open, compose or close a checkpoint workspace. Mutations require requestId.

x-tools.name: tdev_read
x-tools.description: Batch bounded immutable file/list/literal-search/diff/history reads at a checkpoint.

x-tools.name: tdev_edit
x-tools.description: Atomically edit files at expected checkpoint. Same request replays before stale checks.

x-tools.name: tdev_exec
x-tools.description: Run arbitrary commands in the enrolled isolated executor; retained operation handle. Never resubmit with a new request after response loss.

x-tools.name: tdev_process
x-tools.description: Observe retained status/output, send sequenced stdin, cancel, or retire a proved-stopped execution. Status never launches work; retire preserves replay tombstones.

x-tools.name: tdev_validate
x-tools.description: Freeze an exact candidate commit and run the operator's mandatory command through trusted outer execution.

x-tools.name: tdev_publish
x-tools.description: Publish exactly the validated commit with expected-old-head CAS. Never revalidate or regenerate source.

x-semantics.oid: Raw full Git OID, repository object format determines length; checkpoint commit is CAS token.
x-semantics.requestId: Principal-scoped installation-lifetime dedup key. Same payload only; current auth precedes replay.
x-semantics.processStatus: Exactly one of operationId and lookupRequestId is required; neither/both rejected.
x-semantics.result: Workspace list/open/edit results, bounded query items, or retained operation. Operation contains id, kind, status, effect, result/error; running is independent of certainty. Output evidence fields are server-owned, never accepted as validation input.

execution.sourceMetadata: Private shallow Git checkpoint; no remote credentials. Validation HEAD is the frozen candidate commit.
